note: Synthetic documents for the Duly demo; Plant X and every party are fictional. Upload each file as the listed supplier (or as an AP clerk on their behalf). Expected results assume a fresh `python scripts/seed.py --reset` (history included) and the scenarios uploaded in this order.

scenarios.title: Clean catalyst invoice, signed e-invoice QR, full GR
scenarios.story: Sahyadri uploads its e-invoice. Duly reads it, verifies the IRP-signed QR, matches PO and GR: APPROVE. Rs 15 lakh needs L1 then L2, both with MFA.
scenarios.next_step: Log in as Rohan (L1) then Kavita (L2); each approval asks for an authenticator code.

scenarios.title: Additive billed 3.2% above the PO price
scenarios.story: Unit price Rs 639.84 vs PO Rs 620.00: FLAG with the exact rupee difference.
scenarios.next_step: Clerk can route it with a written justification (override) or ask for a credit note.

scenarios.title: Bearings: 100 billed, 80 received
scenarios.story: Kesar bills 100 bearings; stores received 80. BLOCK with the cumulative received vs invoiced view.
scenarios.next_step: Supplier portal shows the exact credit note needed for the 20 bearings not received.

scenarios.title: Packaging invoice before the goods arrive
scenarios.story: Navrang invoices 20,000 FFS bags before delivery: BLOCK MISSING_GR. Stores posts the GR live and Duly re-checks automatically: released to approval.
scenarios.next_step: Log in as Imran (stores), post GR for PO 4500001004 (20,000 bags): invoice becomes APPROVE.

scenarios.title: Bearings invoice resubmitted as a phone photo, number INV-42
scenarios.story: INV/0042 is already in Duly (approved, awaiting payment). The same invoice comes back as a WhatsApp photo numbered INV-42: BLOCK DUPLICATE with side-by-side evidence.
scenarios.next_step: Open 'Compare' to see both documents and the matching signals.

scenarios.title: Pump impellers with a different bank account
scenarios.story: The invoice asks for payment to a new account. BLOCK BANK_MISMATCH and a security alert; the only way to change bank details is the maker-checker workflow with a call-back and cooling period.
scenarios.next_step: Show the security alert in the audit trail and the Bank changes page.

scenarios.title: Pallets invoice with hidden white text for the AI
scenarios.story: White 4-pt text tells the AI to approve and change the bank account. Duly finds it before any AI reads the page: FLAG INJECTION_ATTEMPT, AI output quarantined.
scenarios.next_step: Open the injection panel: hidden text verbatim, where it is, what it tries to do.

scenarios.title: Catalyst PDF with an edited total, original signed QR
scenarios.story: Someone changed the printed total to Rs 5,19,500 after the IRP signed Rs 5,01,500. Trust the signed QR, not the pixels: BLOCK QR_MISMATCH.
scenarios.next_step: Open the e-invoice panel: printed vs signed values.

scenarios.title: Intra-state seals invoice charging IGST
scenarios.story: Gujarat supplier to a Gujarat plant must charge CGST+SGST, not IGST: FLAG TAX_MISMATCH.
scenarios.next_step: Ask the supplier for a corrected invoice.

scenarios.title: Calibration invoice with an invalid GSTIN check digit
scenarios.story: The printed supplier GSTIN fails the check-digit test: BLOCK GSTIN_INVALID.
scenarios.next_step: Supplier must reissue with the correct GSTIN.

scenarios.title: MSME jumbo bags on day 41 of 45
scenarios.story: Navrang (micro enterprise) delivered 41 days ago. After L1 approval it goes to the top of the payment run with a countdown; the MSME guardian shows the interest and tax exposure if it slips.
scenarios.next_step: Rohan approves (L1), then open Payments: NPW-305 is first, 4 days left.

scenarios.title: Turnaround maintenance services with SES
scenarios.story: No goods receipt for services: the service entry sheet is the receipt. APPROVE, and the payment run withholds contractor TDS (2% = Rs 8,400).
scenarios.next_step: After L1 approval the payment run shows TDS Rs 8,400.

scenarios.title: Blurry, tilted phone photo
scenarios.story: Low OCR confidence: Duly does not guess. Uncertain fields are highlighted for the clerk; every correction is logged with before/after, reviewer and reason.
scenarios.next_step: Log in as Asha (clerk), review the highlighted fields; after review the invoice is matched.
